inlineImageAndParagraph.text: NMC Verification confirms if a medical professional is registered with the National Medical Commission (NMC) of India, the statutory body regulating medical practice. Decentro's API instantly validates a doctor's credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official registry, returning name, qualification, and status in real-time for compliant healthcare onboarding.

items.description: Collect the unique NMC registration number of the medical professional to be verified, ensuring accurate identification for the subsequent real-time database query.

Decentro's API securely queries the official National Medical Commission (NMC) database in real-time, cross-referencing the provided registration number against the authoritative source for authenticity.
The API extracts and returns comprehensive practitioner details, including the doctor's full name, qualification, registration date, and current status, providing a complete verified record.

block1.heading:
Instant Registry
Lookup
block1.paragraph: Queries the official NMC database directly in real time, ensuring that all returned data is current and accurate, without reliance on cached or stale records.

block1.heading:
Qualification &
Specialisation Return
block1.paragraph: Retrieves the doctor's degree, specialisation, and comprehensive registration details directly from the official NMC record, ensuring complete and verified professional data.

block1.heading:
Single-Field
Input
block1.paragraph: Only the NMC registration number is needed — no document uploads or additional details required.

block1extra.heading:

Pre-Validation
block1extra.paragraph: Ensures the input format precisely matches NMC's standard registration number pattern through regex-based pre-validation, preventing invalid queries and improving efficiency.

block1extra.heading:
